newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen steady, jobless claims on target.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen steady, jobless claims on target.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open generally steady on Thursday in the last session ahead of Friday's key unemployment, payrolls and wage report, share analysts said.
The U.S. Labor Department reported new jobless claims for the week ended September 28 totalled 340,000, unchanged from the prior week and in line with economists' forecasts.
Once past Friday's wage and payrolls report, assuming the data match forecasts for more tepid growth, analysts expect the Dow to complete its run at the 6,000 mark.
On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 29.07 to a record close of 5,933.97.
